feed.title: Bitcoin Core 32.0rc2 release candidate is available

entry.title: Bitcoin Core 32.0rc2 release candidate is available
entry.summary:
The latest version of Bitcoin Core, v32.0rc2, has recently been made available for download. This version is a release candidate, signaling an impending major version release upon successful testing and no critical issues found. Interested parties can access the binaries at [Bitcoin Core Binaries](https://bitcoincore.org/bin/bitcoin-core-32.0/test.rc2/) and view the source code under the signed tag at [GitHub Source Code](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/tree/v32.0rc2).
For those involved in testing or interested in the specifics of this release, preliminary release notes have been published and can be reviewed at [Release Notes Draft](https://github.com/bitcoin-core/bitcoin-devwiki/wiki/32.0-Release-Notes-Draft). Additionally, a detailed testing guide is available to assist with the evaluation of the release candidate, which can be found at [Testing Guide](https://github.com/bitcoin-core/bitcoin-devwiki/wiki/32.0-Release-Candidate-Testing-Guide).
Developers and testers are encouraged to post any issues or comments regarding this release candidate on the dedicated GitHub page at [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/36315). This step is vital for ensuring that the final release is stable and free of critical problems, facilitating a smooth transition to the official v32.0 release. Participation and feedback from the development community are crucial in this phase to achieve a refined and robust update.
